# dash0_sampling_rule (Resource)

Manages a Dash0 Sampling Rule. Sampling rules decide which traces Dash0 keeps: each rule keeps the traces that match its conditions, such as traces with an error span, traces that match an OTTL expression, or a probabilistic share of all traces. See [Sample Traces](https://dash0.com/docs/dash0/telemetry/signal-control/sample-traces) for the condition kinds and their limits.

~> **Note:** Creating a sampling rule requires an auth token with the admin role.

~> **Note:** `spec.enabled` is required. The provider always sends a value for it, so an omitted field would silently create a disabled rule and later switch off one enabled elsewhere.

Changing `dataset` destroys the rule and re-creates it under a new origin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dash0_sampling_rule" "keep_production_errors" {
  dataset            = "default"
  sampling_rule_yaml = file("${path.module}/sampling_rule.yaml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sampling_rule_yaml` (String) The sampling rule definition in YAML format. The YAML must declare `kind: Dash0Sampling`, an explicit `spec.enabled`, and `spec.conditions`, a tree of `probabilistic`, `ottl`, `error` and `and` conditions. `spec.display.name` and `spec.rateLimit` are optional. `metadata.labels` are ignored during drift detection, so the provider warns when `metadata.labels.custom` is set.

### Optional

- `dataset` (String) The identifier of the [Dash0 dataset](https://dash0.com/docs/dash0/miscellaneous/glossary/datasets) that the sampling rule belongs to. Provide the dataset's identifier, which is immutable, not the 'name'. Datasets are used to separate observability data within a Dash0 organization. If omitted, the provider-level `dataset` default is used (see the provider's `dataset` attribute). Changing this value forces the resource to be recreated under a new origin.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The server-assigned identifier of the sampling rule, resolved by the provider after creation.
- `origin` (String) A unique identifier for the sampling rule, automatically generated on creation. Used to reference the rule for updates, reads, deletes, and imports.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
terraform import dash0_sampling_rule.keep_production_errors default,tf_existing-sampling-rule-origin
```
